description: This file defines functions and constants for parsing date strings according to specific formats, including ISO 8601 and RFC 2822, within the Moment.js library. It handles token-based parsing, meridiem adjustments, and overflow checks.

methods.name: configFromStringAndFormat
methods.description: Parses a date string according to a specified format, handling ISO 8601 and RFC 2822 standards, and updates the configuration object with parsed date parts.

methods.name: meridiemFixWrap
methods.description: Adjusts the hour based on meridiem (AM/PM) information, using locale-specific methods if available.
